subject: Encord Platform Overview and Deployment Patterns
text:
Hi Tejas,

Thanks again for the time earlier this week to review our platform in more
detail and go into greater depth on how you'd think about leveraging our
platform for annotations.  I synced with our team and discussed internally
with our product/engineering team some of the followups we covered.

*Embedded API / integration*
We don't currently support Encord being used as an embedded component
inside a third-party product (i.e. our label editor running inside your own
app). What we do support is our SDK, which gives you programmatic access to
build tighter integrations against your own data pipelines (ingest, export,
workflow triggers, etc) without embedding our UI directly. If a fully
embedded editor experience is a requirement on your end, that's likely a
fundamental mismatch and worth flagging now rather than later in the
process.

*ObjectID linking across 2D and 3D*
Linking the same object across a 2D pass and a 3D/point-cloud pass with a
shared ID. This is an active customer request we are currently working on
and we expect to support it soon.   It's not fully generally available
today, so I don't want to commit to a specific date, but I wanted you to
know it's on our near term roadmap.

*Pricing and deployment pattern*
We're generally focused on annual contracts with long-term customers, so I
want to be upfront about where the pricing lands for the two paths you're
considering:
- SaaS only, for a team of 3-5 users: we're typically in the $40K-$75K/year
range for annotation only, depending on usage and workflow complexity.
- On-prem/air-gapped deployment: this sits meaningfully higher, largely
because of the custom engineering and compliance work involved (data
security standards, air-gapped environments, government-grade integration).
That said, at the moment we are only prioritizing these types of
deployments and resources for direct enterprise customer relationships that
are scaling to large volumes and intend for multi year agreements.

Let me know if you'd like to find time in the coming days to discuss
further.

Best,
